'''DX-TX''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] leader of the [[DX annihilator network]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. This group allied with [[Godoba]] the Hutt and the [[Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance]] to form the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]].<ref name="TOR" />
